title: Split Windows startup-gate --version/--help (50 ms) and status (75 ms) ceilings and record Windows x86_64 measurements
goal: On Windows x86_64 release builds (v0.21.68 candidate target/dist/susi.exe), standalone startup-gate --runs 5 observed process-spawn floor medians of 17.65-18.97 ms and measured medians of 32.89-33.14 ms (version), 34.20-37.96 ms (help), and 48.59-52.03 ms (status_daemon_down/up), failing the Unix-tuned 30.0 ms and 50.0 ms ceilings. Split Windows-only cfg(windows) budgets in xtask/src/bin/startup-gate.rs (VERSION_HELP_BUDGET_MS=50.0, STATUS_BUDGET_MS=75.0) while keeping #[cfg(not(windows))] unchanged (30.0 / 50.0 ms), update unit tests against the named budget constants, and record the rationale and Windows x86_64 measurements in docs/step1-acceptance.md.
limitations: Measured on Windows x86_64 host against prebuilt v0.21.68 target/dist/susi.exe; #[cfg(not(windows))] constants remain 30.0 ms / 50.0 ms unchanged.
